description: This file defines a Java interface JsonExceptionBuilder for constructing mutable builders for JsonException objects. It contains methods to set properties like message, description, cause, and href for a JsonException and to build the exception.

classes.name: JsonExceptionBuilder
classes.description: A generic builder interface for creating instances of JsonException with customizable properties such as message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Sets the detail message for the exception being built.
methods.return: this JsonExceptionBuilder instance for method chaining

methods.name: message
methods.description: Sets the detail message using a supplier, allowing for deferred message creation.
methods.return: this JsonExceptionBuilder instance for method chaining

methods.name: description
methods.description: Sets a description with additional information about the exception.
methods.return: this JsonExceptionBuilder instance for method chaining

methods.name: description
methods.description: Sets a description using a supplier for deferred evaluation.
methods.return: this JsonExceptionBuilder instance for method chaining

methods.name: cause
methods.description: Sets the cause (Throwable) that led to the exception.
methods.return: this JsonExceptionBuilder instance for method chaining

methods.name: cause
methods.description: Sets the cause using a supplier for deferred evaluation.
methods.return: this JsonExceptionBuilder instance for method chaining

methods.name: href
methods.description: Sets a URI link providing further info about the exception.
methods.return: this JsonExceptionBuilder instance for method chaining

methods.name: href
methods.description: Sets the URI via a supplier for deferred evaluation.
methods.return: this JsonExceptionBuilder instance for method chaining

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an instance of JsonException based on the configured data.
